name: Optimal Magikal Ink

phase_0.boundary_condition: the sealed alembic containing the ink and its catalytic medium

VINIT.justification: the blank page before inscription, pure potential

TANCH.justification: the fixed, irreversible record of the spell

AFWD.justification: the forward motion of the pen, inscribing the spell

AREV.justification: the reversal of flow, preparing for reactivation

CLINK.justification: the continuous path of ink from reservoir to pen and back

IMSCRIB.justification: the pen that refills itself, a self-referential loop

FSPLIT.justification: the droplet splits into two: one that writes, one that catalyzes

FFUSE.justification: the two droplets recombine into a single, potent ink

EVALF.justification: the spell misfires or fails to activate

ENGAGR.justification: the spell both succeeds and fails, creating a stable paradox

IFIX.justification: the ink that has dried and cannot be undone

phase_3.void_description: the blank page, no ink present
phase_3.true_description: the spell is successfully inscribed and active
phase_3.false_description: the ink fails to activate the spell
phase_3.both_description: the spell is both active and inactive, a paradoxical state

steps.domain_action: the blank page is prepared, void of ink
the pen is dipped, ink flows forward
the ink droplet splits into writing and catalytic components
the writing droplet inscribes the spell, success
the catalytic droplet fails to activate, failure
the spell exists in a state of both success and failure
the ink retracts, preparing for reactivation
the two droplets recombine into a single potent ink
the self-inking quill recognizes its own state
the ink loop is completed, ready for next cycle
the ink dries, creating a permanent record
the dried ink residue anchors the spell

phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the ink's flow through the quill

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the ink's transformation is a closed cycle, no net entropy
